text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The three-legged race at the Fan 
Appreciation Festival. Umamusume pairs 
with no synergy were fighting an uphill 
battle.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Bono, your stride is way too huge! For 
every step you take, I have to run three 
just to keep up~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, this is tricky...! Want me to put it 
in slow motion~?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy, don't move yet! Uh... to summon 
the magic carpet, it was...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um-um... it might actually be faster to 
just run normally...!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: As a princess, even further ahead!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
E-Every pair's movements are completely 
out of sync, aren't they? At any rate, as 
quickly as possible—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We'll find one, a solution! There's bound 
to be a way for the two of us to get in 
sync!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I know! Times like this call for *that* 
classic trope!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"And then, something miraculous happened! 
Thanks to Pegasus Power, my stride just 
lengthened on its own...!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hurry, hurry! Rob Roy, you're more used to 
reading books, right? Find the spell 
quick--!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh...! I-I really feel like it'd be 
faster to just run...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami! Keep your ego in check and 
cooperate humbly here.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Stay humble! Lead the entire world!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Stay humble! And push even further ahead!
